automatic_detection: source model lifecycle indicates deprecated or retired
source model is absent from the current verified selector
user explicitly requests migration to another model/provider
no_migration_needed: source model remains verified and default_policy is include, unless the user explicitly requests a migration

required_before_automatic_target_selecti: required input/context budget when materially relevant
required output budget when materially relevant
required capabilities and modalities that are essential to the prompt

filtering.context: Candidate context_window_tokens must meet required_context_tokens when supplied.
filtering.output: Candidate max_output_tokens must meet required_output_tokens when supplied.
filtering.capabilities: Every required capability must be explicitly verified as supported. Unknown capability evidence cannot silently pass.
filtering.modalities: Every required modality must be positively compatible when modality requirements are supplied.
filtering.price: Optional max input/output price constraints are hard filters when comparable normalized pricing is available.

auto_select_when: exactly one eligible candidate remains after all hard constraints
or a provider-documented replacement identifier is available and that replacement passes all hard constraints
needs_review_when: more than one eligible candidate remains without a documented replacement
only warning/specialized candidates remain and user intent does not establish acceptance
cross-provider migration would be required without prior user authorization
selection.selection_basis: verified hard constraints and documented replacement evidence only

statuses.not_needed: Current target remains verified and usable and no migration was requested.
statuses.plan_ready: A migration target is uniquely established by verified evidence and declared constraints.
statuses.needs_review: A safe automatic target cannot be uniquely established.
statuses.blocked: Current registry/runtime health is insufficient for a trustworthy migration plan.
